existing_tips: 'com quem' – preposition + 'quem' for people in relative clauses. The preposition must come before t
Formal imperatives use the subjunctive: 'Faça o favor' (Please do), 'Sente-se' (Sit down) – used wit
'Olha só' is an informal expression used to draw attention.
